foreshadow_entries.description: As Kaito exits the Council Chamber, Varen's aide mutters to a guard: 'Watch him. If he touches the ledgers, he dies.' The guard nods without expression.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: council chamber exit — whispered threat between Varen's aide and a guard
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: cathedral archive investigation — Kaito finds a ledger entry showing the previous royal accountant was found dead the day after auditing Duskwood accounts

foreshadow_entries.description: During the Council session, a close-up reveals a silver ring on Lord Harrow's finger bearing a three-crossed-swords motif — the sigil of Veldrath.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: council chamber — close-up insert shot of a noble's hand during the audit reading
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: council hearing — Kaito recognizes the same crossed-swords motif on the wax seal of the forged letters Varen presents

foreshadow_entries.description: Maester Orin tells Kaito the Royal Crystal Reserve holds 'six months of operational capital, by the official tally' — then pauses, adjusts his spectacles, and adds 'by the official tally' a second time, more quietly.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: royal library — quiet conversation between Kaito and Orin over dusty ledgers
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: crystal vault inspection — Kaito opens the vault and finds it nearly empty; Orin admits the true figure is eight weeks

foreshadow_entries.description: Captain Rennick is seen slipping out a side door of the Duskwood wing of the castle late at night, adjusting his collar and looking over his shoulder.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: castle corridor at night — silent visual of Rennick leaving a restricted wing
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: harvest council assassination attempt — Rennick is conspicuously absent from his post when the arrow flies, and a guard notes he 'had an errand'

foreshadow_entries.description: King Aldric's hands tremble in a slow, rhythmic pattern — three small spasms, then stillness, then three again — as he reaches for a glass of water during Elara's visit.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: royal bedchamber — intimate scene of Elara visiting her father; close-up on his trembling hands
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: harvest council aftermath — Elara recognizes the same tremor pattern in a council servant and realizes it matches crystal-dust poisoning

foreshadow_entries.description: Corvin 'Coal' Thatch, alone in his Rusted Gate hovel, pulls a faintly glowing crystal shard from his coat. It whispers — a low, rhythmic sound like breath. He closes his fist around it and says: 'Not yet.'
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: Rusted Gate hovel at night — solitary scene of Corvin with the shard
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: Thornwood clan village — Old Morwen recognizes the shard as a fragment of the original cage and explains what it is

foreshadow_entries.description: Lord Garrick Harrow corners Kaito in a corridor and says quietly: 'Varen has been corresponding with someone in the eastern court. I have seen the seal. Three swords, crossed.' He walks away before Kaito can respond.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: castle corridor — brief, tense exchange between Harrow and Kaito
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: council session — Veldrath ultimatum arrives; Kaito connects the crossed-swords seal to Varen's correspondence and confronts him publicly

foreshadow_entries.description: A miner runs screaming from the deep shaft, his hair turned white, his eyes glowing faint crystal-blue. He collapses and dies before he can speak. Kael orders the shaft sealed.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: mine entrance — chaotic scene of a dying miner emerging from the deep shaft
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: mine collapse aftermath — Kaito realizes the miner's crystal-blue eyes match the growths appearing on livestock and the pattern of infrastructure failures

foreshadow_entries.description: 'Deep' Marta rolls up her sleeve to show Kaito a scar on her forearm — the flesh around it has a faint, crystalline sheen that catches the lamplight. She says nothing, only watches his reaction.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: miner bunkhouse — quiet interview between Kaito and Marta
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: mine collapse aftermath — Kaito sees the same crystalline sheen on the bodies of miners pulled from the rubble, and understands what the deep levels do to human flesh

foreshadow_entries.description: 'Silver' Sanna leans close to Kaito in the Drowned Rat and murmurs: 'Veldrath is not buying crystal. They are buying silence. Ask yourself who in Aurelian has been paid to stop talking.'
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: dockside tavern — whispered conversation over drinks
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: Ironveil Mountains — Thane Brynn reveals the dwarves stopped mining two hundred years ago and have been paying Aldorian nobles to keep the deep shafts sealed

foreshadow_entries.description: High Confessor Halvor tells Elara: 'Your father is not dying. He is being killed.' When she demands a name, he says only: 'The hand is noble. The coin is foreign. The order is old.'
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: Saltmere chapel — private audience between Halvor and Elara
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: Vane estate investigation — Elara uncovers the poison payment chain leading from House Vane through foreign intermediaries to Varen's coffers

foreshadow_entries.description: Brother Aldous, alone in the archive after Kaito and Elara leave, removes a hidden tome from a locked case. The title reads 'On the Hunger Beneath.' He feeds it into the brazier and watches it burn.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: cathedral archive — solitary scene of Aldous burning the book
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: kingdom-wide omens — Kaito realizes the pre-crystal collapse followed the same pattern as the current infrastructure failures, and that Aldous destroyed evidence

foreshadow_entries.description: Captain Rennick, alone in his quarters, burns a letter bearing the Duskwood wolf sigil. His hands tremble as he holds the paper to the candle flame.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: Royal Guard captain's quarters — solitary night scene of Rennick burning a letter
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: Vane estate investigation — Elara finds a ledger of payments from House Duskwood to a 'Captain R.' and confronts Rennick, who confesses his betrayal

foreshadow_entries.description: Old Morwen presses a carved stone into Elara's hand and says: 'When the second moon rises, break this. Not before. And do not tell the Church.' The stone is warm to the touch.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: Thornwood clan village — Old Morwen's hut, firelit, quiet
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: second moon appearance — Elara feels the stone grow hot as the second moon rises; she prepares to break it as instructed

foreshadow_entries.description: Kaito receives an unsigned letter slipped under his door: 'Varen has already sold the mines. The wolves are already inside.' The handwriting is unfamiliar, but the paper smells faintly of Veldrath incense.
foreshadow_entries.planted_scene_hint: Kaito's chambers — discovery of the anonymous letter at dawn
foreshadow_entries.payoff_scene_hint: Long Night assassination — Varen's assassins strike inside the castle, proving the wolves were already inside as the letter warned
